title: Darkiss! Wrath of the Vampire - Chapter 1: the Awakening
author: Marco Vallarino
description: You're the nightmare from which people can't wake. Dead twice. One by the hand of your maker, the second by the fiend who drove a stake through your heart while you were sleeping defenceless in your coffin. Alive thrice, it seems, although this last one shouldn't be possible. Something happened.
